title: Debounce
description:
Implement a `debounce` function that delays invoking `fn` until `delay` ms have elapsed since the last call. Returns the debounced function.

**Example:**
```js
const save = debounce(() => saveToServer(), 300);
save(); save(); save(); // saveToServer called once after 300ms
```
ai_context: Common mistake: forgetting to clear the previous timer on each call, so fn fires multiple times. Also forgetting to pass ...args to fn.
